# Third-party component: OBS Virtual Camera

`obs-virtualcam-module32.dll` and `obs-virtualcam-module64.dll` are the
virtual-camera DirectShow filter from [OBS Studio](https://obsproject.com/)
(https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio), redistributed unmodified.

OBS Studio is licensed under the GNU General Public License v2.0. Its full
source code is available at https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio.

These two files are the only OBS Studio component this project uses or
installs — the full OBS Studio application is not required.
